newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's to review Hokkaido Takushoku rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's to review Hokkaido Takushoku rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service Ltd said on Thursday that it would review Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd's deposit rating for a possible downgrade.
Moody's currently assigns "Baa3/P-3" ratings to the bank's deposits.

Japan's 10th largest commercial bank announced on Tuesday that it would merge with the smaller Hokkaido Bank Ltd as equals by April 1998 and cease overseas operations to try to become a "super regional" bank.
The review is in response to the merger announcement, Moody's said in a statement.
The "Baa3/Prime-3" deposit ratings and "E+" bank financial strength rating of Hokkaido Bank were also placed on review for possible downgrade on March 19.

Moody's said the review of Hokkaido Takushoku ratings would focus on the bank's progress in problem-asset reduction, as well as the merged bank's prospective profitability and the degree of support it may expect from Japanese authorities.
